title: A newly issued credential: the only response that ever carries the token (POST /api/_a2app/credentials, POST /api/_a2app/auth/token, POST /api/_a2app/tasks/{id}/credential).

token.description: `a2a_` + 256 random bits, base64url. Shown once: the app stores only its SHA-256. Sent as X-A2App-Token.
